title: Lewis Chase reports to Air Force headquarters and Condon

tellings.quote: Um and so, uh Chase decides he needs to report all this. Um, and he does in a a telegram to Air Force headquarters and also reports to Edward Condan.

plain: After the 1967 incident at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, in which Robert Salas says a UFO shut down ten nuclear missiles, a man named Lewis Chase decided it all had to be reported, and he did so in a telegram to Air Force headquarters and in a report to Edward Condon, the physicist then leading a university UFO study for the Air Force. Salas, a former Air Force officer who says he was there that year, tells Michels about these two papers. He tells it because it would mean the incident went up the chain to the top, on the record.
